content: Idiomatic requests retry: build urllib3.util.Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=1, status_forcelist=[429,500,502,503,504], respect_retry_after_header=True), wrap in requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries), mount on a requests.Session for both http:// and https://. backoff formula = backoff_factor * (2 ** (retry_count - 1)) matching D-01's 1s/2s/4s sequence with backoff_factor=1.
